about: GeostatsPy gamv (MIT) - reference for bf_core.geostat.variogram.pairs (TZ 7.35 D-21, ADR 0012); regenerated by the throw-away script in generator_source; see known_defects
known_defects: geostatspy.gamv counts every pair twice (i, j and j, i) and an omnidirectional one twice again; index il of the result is centred on (il - 1)*xlag, il = 0 holds the pairs with h <= 1e-20 (the self-pairs)

geostatspy.gamv_3D calls variogram_loop_3D, which 0.0.46 does not define: the 3D cases call its loop geostatspy.geostats.cova directly; its 3D band (distance to the line) and dip test (3D cosine) are not those of GSLIB gamv, so only horizontal directions with dip tolerance 90 and no band are kept, and the data have no vertical pairs (cova rejects them, GSLIB keeps them)
geostatspy takes the azimuth vector as cos/sin((90 - azm)*pi/180): cos(pi/2) = 6.1e-17, not 0 - no pair of the data lies on the edge of a cone
